<$comeff(4,14)><$motion(4,805)><$voicel(4,5)>*sniff sniff*
I can smell something...
<$emotion(4,14)><$voicel(4,7)>Hey, so, uh... I think I can smell a <$cdef(27)>spring</color> around here.
<$comcan(4)><$motion(4,807)><$voicel(4,7)>No, no... I smell a <$cdef(27)>spring</color>. Y’know, like, spring water?

<$motion(4,661)><$voicel(4,5)>So... There are some places where water just, y’know,
gushes out of the wall! Those are <$cdef(27)>springs.

<$motion(4,805)><$voicel(4,7)>I can SMELL one, but I don’t see it anywhere...<$comeff(4,10)><$motion(4,803)><$voicel(4,10)> That
must mean it’s hiding, right?

<$comeff(4,14)><$motion(4,805)><$voicel(4,5)>Once we find a <$cdef(27)>spring, we can let the water out and get it
really flowing! <$voicel(4,8)>That’ll make a pool, right?<$comeff(4,9)><$facial(4,4)><$motion(4,801)><$voicel(4,9)> That’s sure
to make this whole area more...uh, humid.
<$comeff(4,6)><$motion(4,803)><$voicel(4,6)>Did you find a <$cdef(27)>spring</color> hiding anywhere?

<$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,805)><$voicel(2,5)>*sniff sniff* Hmmm... I swear the smell of water’s coming
from somewhere around here...

<$comeff(2,3)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,7)>Huh? You’re looking for a spring,
<$cdef(27)>?
<$emotion(2,38)><$voicel(2,10)>I think it’s gotta be somewhere near here!

<$emotion(2,38)><$voicel(2,9)>Great job, <$cdef(27)>! You found
the spring!
<$comeff(2,6)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,805)><$voicel(2,7)>That should help make this area a little bit more humid!
<$emotion(2,60)><$voicel(2,10)>I wonder if <$cdef(27)>Slowpoke</color> can yawn properly now!

<$comeff(4,6)><$motion(4,803)><$voicel(4,5)>Oh, hey there, <$cdef(27)>. Did you find
that,
uh...<$cdef(27)>spring
we
were
looking for...?

<$comeff(4,10)><$facial(4,4)><$motion(4,801)><$voicel(4,9)>Oooh, yaaay! I was wondering why it suddenly got a little
more humid around here...
<$comeff(4,9)><$facial(4,4)><$motion(4,805)><$voicel(4,7)>I bet there are still some <$cdef(27)>springs out there... Maybe you
could find some more?
<$comeff(4,20)><$motion(4,803)><$voicel(4,7)>Ooh, I just had a really good idea!

<$comeff(4,6)><$facial(4,1)><$motion(4,805)><$voicel(4,5)>OK, so, you know how you found all those <$cdef(27)>springs, right?
<$comeff(4,14)><$voicel(4,7)>Well, maybe if we put like, a <$cdef(27)>fountain near one, then
the water could splash around! <$comeff(4,9)><$facial(4,4)><$motion(4,801)><$voicel(4,6)>Don’t you think that’d
make things even more humid?

<$comeff(4,14)><$facial(4,1)><$motion(4,805)><$voicel(4,5)>I guess we need to find a <$cdef(27)>fountain somewhere, huh?
<$comeff(4,10)><$facial(4,4)><$motion(4,801)><$voicel(4,9)>I’m sure you can do it! I believe in you!

<$comeff(4,14)><$facial(4,1)><$motion(4,805)><$voicel(4,5)>I guess we need to find a <$cdef(27)>fountain somewhere, huh?
<$voicel(4,8)>I think I saw one, um...somewhere, but...

<$comcan(4)>Once you find a <$cdef(27)>fountain, try placing it in a pool of
spring water!
The water flowing from the <$cdef(27)>fountain will humidify the
surrounding area!

<$comeff(4,10)><$facial(4,4)><$motion(4,801)><$voicel(4,9)>A <$cdef(27)>fountain would help humidify the air even more...
Uh, probably...

Once you find a <$cdef(27)>fountain, try placing it in a pool of
spring water!
The water flowing from the <$cdef(27)>fountain will humidify the
surrounding area!
<$comeff(4,9)><$facial(4,4)><$motion(4,803)><$voicel(4,5)>Oooh, you set up a <$cdef(27)><fqty(1)><$ifull(1262)></color>! Thanks so much!
<$comeff(4,10)><$facial(4,4)><$motion(4,801)><$voicel(4,7)>I can feel it getting more humid around here!

<$emotion(1,29)><$voicel(1,7)>Did you find a spring, <$cdef(27)>? Perhaps
that’s
what
raised
the humidity!
<$emotion(1,38)><$voicel(1,9)>I think there should be several springs around here!

<$emotion(1,38)><$voicel(1,9)>Ahhh, the air feels more humid now, thanks to the
<$cdef(27)><$ifull(1262)>.
<$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,7)>I can’t wait to witness <$cdef(27)>Slowpoke</color>’s yawn!

<$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,824)><$voicel(1,7)>The other Pokémon have given you some good advice.
<$voicel(1,5)>It sounds like finding springs of water or adding more
plant life <$voicel(1,8)>around here would help.

<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,664)><$voicel(1,9)>And don’t forget to check up on <$cdef(27)>Slowpoke’s yawns every
now and then!

<$voicel(4,5)><$motion(4,803)>I wanted to go...somewhere? Uhhh... Oh! Right! I wanted
to go to the <$cdef(27)>professor!
<$voicel(4,7)><$comeff(4,10)>Do you think you could clear a path for me?

If you place steps where the terrain is different heights,
Pokémon will be able to walk more easily.

Also, Pokémon can walk much farther on moistened paths
than on dried-up ground.

<$comeff(4,14)><$facial(4,1)><$motion(4,805)><$voicel(4,5)>Hey, know what I noticed? There’s, uh, spring water
around here!

<$comeff(4,10)><$facial(4,4)><$motion(4,805)><$voicel(4,7)>Were you the one who found that? That’s so cool.
<$motion(4,661)><$voicel(4,6)><$comeff(4,3)><$facial(4,1)>You know what I’m talking about, right? <$cdef(27)>Spring water? The
water that kinda, um, gushes out of walls and stuff. I think.

<$comeff(4,14)><$facial(4,1)><$motion(4,661)><$voicel(4,5)>Letting spring water flow and pool up will make
stuff, <$voicel(4,7)>y’know...real soggy. Uh, humid? Yeah, humid.

<$comeff(4,3)><$facial(4,1)><$motion(4,805)><$voicel(4,6)>The air here used to be so dry...
<$comeff(4,21)><$facial(4,4)><$motion(4,661)><$voicel(4,9)>But now, it’s getting all nice and uh, humid! Thanks to you.
<$voicel(4,7)>Please keep up the good work!

<$comeff(4,3)><$motion(4,803)><$voicel(4,7)>Hey, <$cdef(27)>, you know that
<$cdef(27)><$ifull(1262)>
sitting
in
that water?
It’s, y’know, super nice, right? Yeah, real nice.

<$comeff(4,13)><$facial(4,4)><$motion(4,805)><$voicel(4,9)>All that water splishing and uh, splashing... Splish-splash,
splish-splash. <$voicel(4,8)>The fountain sure makes things feel more
humid around here, it does.

<$facial(4,1)><$comcan(4)>Slowpoke is right! If you put a fountain in the pool of water
that collects below a spring, it will gush water that makes
the surrounding air more humid!
